profile.name: DEBYEFLEX 3003 X射线发生器
profile.description: DEBYEFLEX 3003 是一台实验室用 X 射线发生器/管系统，可设置管电流和高压、控制快门并进行定时曝光。它通常作为 X 射线衍射及相关材料表征实验中的辐射源使用。
profile.description_en: The DEBYEFLEX 3003 is a laboratory X-ray generator / tube system with controllable tube current, high voltage, shutter control, and timed exposure functions. It is typically used as an X-ray source for X-ray diffraction and related materials characterization experiments.

registry.name: Rich. Seifert & Co. ISO-DEBYEFLEX 3003 X-Ray tube
registry.description: Debyeflex3003是由Rich. Seifert & Co.生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、写入数据、初始化、打开、状态查询、电压设置。支持Signal, Slot, activate timer等操作。
